Use @source not to exclude directories from Tailwind class scanning.
Use the `source()` function to explicitly set the base path for Tailwind's class name scanning.
Use @source not inline() to prevent specific classes from being generated in Tailwind CSS.

content.text:
This confirms the root cause: Tailwind scans source files as plain text and can't resolve server-side interpolation like `{{ Vite::image(...) }}` inside `bg-[url('...')]`. Since the class isn't a complete, static string at build time, Tailwind never generates the CSS for it.

**Source:** `src/docs/detecting-classes-in-source-files.mdx` — "Overview → Dynamic class names" (lines 65–131)

That's why switching to an inline `style="background-image: url(...)"` works — it bypasses Tailwind's scanner entirely, since it's plain CSS, not a utility class.
